meta.name: Bosch: El Legado
meta.description: Serie de TV (2022-2025). 3 temporadas, 26 episodios. Bosch se embarca en el siguiente capítulo de su carrera y se encuentra trabajando con su antigua enemiga, Honey Chandler.

videos.title: El lado equivocado del adiós
videos.overview: Detective jubilado Harry Bosch, ahora investigador privado, es contratado por la anciana multimillonaria Whitney Vance para manejar un asunto personal con importantes implicaciones. Cuando el hombre que ordenó su asesinato hace un año y medio sale libre, Honey "Money" Chandler, devastada, une a Bosch para arreglar la injusticia. Maddie Bosch, que aún encuentra su camino como policía de patrulla novata, es asignada a un oficial de entrenamiento de carga dura.

videos.title: Bombeado
videos.overview: El regreso de Honey Chandler a la sala del tribunal continúa mientras lucha para defender a un vagabundo acusado injustamente de asesinato. Bosch se concentra en Carl Rogers y localiza a un personaje importante relacionado con el pasado atormentado de Vance. Maddie y su oficial de entrenamiento, Reina Vásquez, tienen su primera aventura como compañeras.

videos.title: Mensaje en una botella
videos.overview: La búsqueda de Carl Rogers por parte de Bosch y Chandler se cruza inesperadamente con el crimen organizado ruso. Una escalofriante escena del crimen en Thai Town obliga a Maddie a enfrentar los límites de su trabajo.

videos.title: Herraduras y granadas de mano
videos.overview: Mientras Bosch profundiza en el pasado de Whitney Vance, otras fuerzas poderosas en juego monitorean cada uno de sus movimientos. Chandler defiende a un hombre en un caso de arresto injusto. Carl Rogers se ve obligado a tramar un nuevo plan. Maddie lucha con el costo emocional de su trabajo.

videos.title: Plan B
videos.overview: La historia de Whitney Vance da un giro inesperado, lo que complica la investigación de Bosch. Bosch y Chandler conspiran para darle la vuelta a Rogers. Maddie lucha por llevarse su trabajo a casa.

videos.title: Cadena de autenticidad
videos.overview: ¿Podrá Carl Rogers superar a Bosch y Chandler y escapar de la justicia una vez más? Maddie Bosch se enfrenta al mayor miedo de todo policía.

videos.title: Uno de los tuyos
videos.overview: Bosch se hace cargo de un caso de asesinato que la policía de Los Ángeles pensó que había resuelto. Maddie se ha metido en la persecución del departamento de un tirador de policías. Chandler lucha con las consecuencias de Carl Rogers.

videos.title: Linaje
videos.overview: A medida que el caso Vance entra en una nueva fase, Bosch se enfrenta a una amenaza cada vez mayor. Un controvertido tiroteo policial atrapa tanto a Maddie como a Chandler.

videos.title: ¿El gato tiene un nombre?
videos.overview: La verdad detrás de la muerte de Whitney Vance finalmente sale a la luz. Maddie ayuda con una ruptura importante en el caso de Screen Cutter. Chandler construye su mejor caso contra la policía de Los Ángeles.

videos.title: Siempre/Todas las formas
videos.overview: Bosch llega a un final peligroso en el caso Vance. Chandler corteja a un aliado poco probable en su demanda por homicidio culposo. Maddie paga el costo de involucrarse demasiado en su trabajo.

videos.title: The Lady Vanishes
videos.overview: Maddie’s gone missing, and it’s all hands on deck to find her. Bosch allies with Chandler, Mo, and an old friend in a race against the clock to save his daughter’s life.

videos.title: Zzyzx
videos.overview: The Screen Cutter attempts to bargain with Bosch and Chandler, who go to extremes to locate Maddie before it’s too late.

videos.title: Inside Man
videos.overview: Chandler enlists Bosch to defend a man accused of a brutal crime. Back on the job, Maddie struggles to find her footing. The FBI sets its sights on Bosch and Chandler.

videos.title: Musso & Frank
videos.overview: Bosch digs into the Lexi Parks murder. Chandler’s new case attracts all the wrong attention. Maddie accepts an exciting assignment that partners her once again with Reina Vasquez.

videos.title: Hollywood Forever
videos.overview: Bosch follows a hunch in the Parks case, but it backfires on him. Maddie hits the streets with Vasquez in her first CRU caper. Mo meets his match at a hackers' conference. Chandler starts playing the long game against the FBI. Ellis and Long keep a close eye on Bosch and Chandler.

videos.title: Dos Matadores
videos.overview: Bosch looks into another murder that might be tied to the Parks case. Chandler clashes with the DA over the fate of David Foster. Kurt Dockweiler's sentencing looms over Maddie. Mo hatches a risky scheme to help Jade Quinn. Ellis and Long begin to feel the heat.

videos.title: I Miss Vin Scully
videos.overview: Bosch starts to unravel the Lexi Parks murder, with potentially dangerous consequences. Chandler tries to outmaneuver the Feds as the case against her hangs in the balance. Ellis and Long get a little too close for comfort.

videos.title: Seventy-Four Degrees in Belize
videos.overview: Everything comes to light in the Parks murder case. The FBI hit Bosch and Chandler where it hurts.

videos.title: Escape Plan
videos.overview: Bosch and Chandler secure key witnesses against Ellis and Long. Chandler enters her endgame with the Feds. With Ellis in the wind, Maddie and CRU are tasked with protecting Bosch.

videos.title: A Step Ahead
videos.overview: Bosch ensures the Lexi Parks case reaches its just conclusion. Chandler considers a big career change with the help of an old acquaintance. Maddie wrestles with the fallout of her first officer-involved shooting. Mo faces a serious ultimatum with the FBI.

videos.title: Goes Where It Goes
videos.overview: Bosch must stop a serious threat to Chandler's run for DA. Maddie and Vasquez are drawn into a follow-home robbery case. An investigation commences into Bosch's possible involvement in Kurt Dockweiler's suspicious death.

videos.title: Bosching Bosch
videos.overview: Bosch takes on the case of a missing family of four. Chandler seeks to flip a powerful campaign donor. The follow-home robbers scheme as the cops get closer. Jimmy Robertson digs deeper into the Bosch investigation.

videos.title: Blankie
videos.overview: Bosch continues his investigation into the Gallagher family disappearance, focusing on Stephen Gallagher's business. Infighting in the follow-home robbery crew gives Vasquez and Maddie a lead. Chandler's association with Bosch comes under scrutiny, threatening her campaign.

videos.title: Whippoorwills
videos.overview: Chandler and her team do damage control after the debate. Maddie and Vasquez zero in on the loot from the robberies. Bosch answers to the grand jury. Robertson and Lopez bring Preston Borders to LA to testify.

videos.title: F***ing Politics
videos.overview: After the Gallagher case grows more complicated, Bosch focuses on discovering the fate of the family. Maddie and Vasquez set a trap for the follow-home crew. Chandler and team make the final push before the DA election. Political calculations impede Robertson and Lopez’s case work.

videos.title: Broken Order
videos.overview: A month after the election, Chandler’s first big case as DA is prosecuting a cop killer. Bosch is brought on to help shore up the case. A break in the follow-home case leads Vasquez to a startling discovery.

videos.title: Welcome to the Other Side
videos.overview: Chandler comes under fire from the chief of police. Bosch works a Juan Doe case he thinks may be connected to another murder, while Mo tries to locate Finbar McShane. Vasquez confirms her suspicions, while Maddie continues working the follow-home case.

videos.title: La Zona Rosa
videos.overview: Bosch and Lopez continue investigating the Juan Doe case. Chandler begins to win the trust of her team. Maddie and Vasquez zero in on the follow-home crew.

videos.title: Badlands
videos.overview: Bosch enlists an old war buddy to bring down Finbar McShane, but Maddie worries her father may cross a dangerous line. Vasquez deals with the emotional fallout of the follow-home cases. Chandler takes charge of a high-stakes case.

videos.title: Dig Down
videos.overview: Bosch clashes with RHD detective Renee Ballard as they attempt to catch the "flower girls" serial killer before another victim is claimed.
